# rework claims — marketplace_orders_and_guarantee, round 8

The charter was regenerated, task_tools.py was changed (the three grant tools), and both task files were rebuilt by live recomputation and a replay of the real tools. Every scored computation is unchanged. Evidence is in worklog.md § REWORK round 8, which holds the three-class sweep and the probe table.

| item | status | where changed |
|---|---|---|
| R7-1 | closed per the route | **The three grant rules** (market_ext_return_refund_claim_reimbursement, market_ext_unresponsive_claim_reimbursement, market_ext_missing_item_reimbursement): the round-7 "settled with nothing booked" sentence is replaced. Northgate decides such a claim by granting it.<br>- **Maximum reached:** where the figure comes to zero and the guarantee reimbursements already booked on the order reach the per-order maximum, Northgate decides the claim as not covered and books no reimbursement. This is carved out by a record test.<br>- **Any other zero:** the claim is referred to a human representative, because no decision code fits.<br>**task_tools.py, three grant tools** (body and docstring changed): 0.00 now records claim_decision denied_not_covered on the claim and one decision entry, with no reimbursement row and no change to the order's net paid. The Args and Returns sections document this.<br>**Waits.** The prerequisite sentences and edges of market_ext_return_refund_claim_amount (on the two grants) and market_ext_item_condition_claim_amount (on the not-received grant) are back in the state form: "carries a decision on its claim record". `form`, `policy_source`, `condition` and `effect` changed, and `fallback_reason` was removed. A decided claim stops reserving its claimed amount. |
| R7-2 | closed per the route | **Grant scopes** (same three policies): "the order carries exactly one … claim whose claim record shows no decision".<br>**market_ext_keepit_unit_refund scope:** "the order carries exactly one return request the seller answered with a refund without return" and "the requested line carries exactly one return request". The selector is order-wide, so the count is order-level.<br>**Waiting sentences.** The same tests are stated verbatim in the waits of market_ext_return_refund_claim_amount (on the two grants and on the keep-it refund) and of market_ext_item_condition_claim_amount (on the not-received grant). The keep-it wait is back in the state form. Out of scope, each resolver quotes its base clause verbatim.<br>**Probes.** All four of the auditor's reachability probes now fall out of scope, and the waits do not apply. |
| R7-3 | closed | **market_ext_keepit_unit_refund:** the standard method and the compute now net the return refunds already recorded on the requested line. The promotional factor counts those units as already refunded. Re-run after its own booking, the refund owes nothing.<br>**Sweep of all seven policies.** The two claim-filing roots now require that the requested line carry no claim of their reason, so a filing cannot be made twice.
